question: In which year was the PM JI-VAN (Biofuel-Vatra Sukla Crop Residue Removal) scheme launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
